doc.title: Nick Brignola interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 28, 1997

title: Serge Chaloff and baritone influences
summary: He says he never listened to Chaloff while developing but recently found him a great player.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: He had quite a character on baritone for a while, was it Serge?
Oh, yeah, I heard all the Serge stories.

Serge Chaloff, yeah. People used to say “you must have listened to Serge—” I never listened to Serge Chaloff. I mean Serge died when I first started to play. And he didn’t record a lot of records. I heard about him, and the few times I heard him, he didn’t knock me out. I wasn’t too interested. I was like, well yeah he plays good, but I don’t know, it doesn’t knock me. out. But lately I’ve listened to him. I’ve listened to some records that were re-released and maybe I think there were records that maybe were never released, some recordings. And he was a hell of a player. So maybe he’ll influence me now or something, I don’t know.
